meta.name: The Hockey Girls 720p
meta.description: The passionate members of a girls' roller hockey team chase down victories in the rink while striving to make time for school, family and romance.

videos.title: Emma
videos.overview: The passionate members of a women's roller hockey team strive to keep their beloved team afloat. Meanwhile, an injured former player returns.

videos.title: Anna
videos.overview: As Anna nervously prepares to coach her first game, a harsh truth rocks Santi and Núria. Meanwhile, Emma receives some devastating news.

videos.title: Berta
videos.overview: While Berta searches for a solution to an impossible situation, Sílvia asks Enric for another chance and Anna takes a reluctant walk down memory lane.

videos.title: Lorena
videos.overview: Fed up with her mother's new relationship, Lorena makes a move. Berta stands up for herself. The girls challenge the boys for use of the locker room.

videos.title: Raquel
videos.overview: Raquel considers taking a big step with Oscar. An unexpected guest surprises Anna and Emma. Youssef shares an explosive secret with Terrats.

videos.title: Flor
videos.overview: Birthday girl Flor seeks a way to reconnect with her girlfriend in Argentina. Anna prepares her team for a big game against their old coach.

videos.title: Gina
videos.overview: Worried about letting down her new teammates and losing Lorena, Gina struggles with nerves. Enric pals around with Pela. Berta shares bold photos.

videos.title: Laila
videos.overview: With exams looming, Laila faces a difficult decision. Berta fights back against a mysterious foe. Enric produces a promo video about the team.

videos.title: Anna & Germán
videos.overview: While Anna and Germán are forced to spend time together, the boys and girls teams hang out at Pela's house, where disaster strikes.

videos.title: Together
videos.overview: As everyone struggles to accept a momentous loss, Lorena looks for a way to honor a loved one. Anna prepares for a challenging legal battle.

videos.title: Friends
videos.overview: Emma's investigation into her past catches her parents off guard. Tensions rise between Santi and Enric. Germán considers a trip.

videos.title: The Match
videos.overview: Anna and the team prepare for a match destined to impact all their lives. Meanwhile, Lorena ponders the possibilities of leaving town.

videos.title: The Club
videos.overview: Relationships begin and end as the team members pin their hopes on Terrats defeating Enric in the election.
